message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "# This workflow will install Python dependencies, run tests and lint with a variety of Python versions
# For more information see: https://help.github.com/actions/language-and-framework-guides/using-python-with-github-actions

name: Textstat

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9", "3.10", "3.11", "3.12", "3.13", "3.14.0-beta.1"]

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('Pipfile.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          python -m pip install pipenv
          pipenv install --dev

      - name: Check code spelling
        run: |
          pipenv run codespell -L paket,nd --skip=./textstat/resources/**/easy_words.txt,./build/*,./textstat.egg-info/*,./.git/*,./tests/* --exclude-file=.codespellignorelines

      - name: Lint with flake8
        run: |
          pipenv run flake8 . --exclude=build/ --max-line-length=88

      - name: Test with pytest
        run: |
          pipenv run pytest .

      - name: Test installing
        run: |
          pip install .",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs pip/pipenv dependency installation on every matrix job across six Python versions with no dependency cache, so dependencies are re-fetched repeatedly. Measured CI workflow evidence (P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE experiment examples on Python pip+pytest workflows) shows adding actions/cache for pip dependencies reduced elapsed CI time by roughly 9-10% while preserving all test steps. Prerequisites are met: repeated dependency fetching is measurable, and the cache key can be bound to the lockfile. The change is minimal (one cache step before dependency installation), preserves every existing build/test/lint step and required check, adds no permissions, secrets, privileged actions, publishing/deployment, or new network access beyond the existing pip use.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2", "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-3d6f1c5a422aa116-r2"]
}
